SELECT AirportCode
FROM airports
WHERE AirportCode IN (
    SELECT SourceAirport
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY SourceAirport
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT MIN(cnt)
        FROM (
            SELECT SourceAirport AS Airport, COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM flights
            GROUP BY SourceAirport
        ) AS sub
    )
)
UNION
SELECT AirportCode
FROM airports
WHERE AirportCode IN (
    SELECT DestAirport
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY DestAirport
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT MIN(cnt)
        FROM (
            SELECT DestAirport AS Airport, COUNT(*) AS cnt
            FROM flights
            GROUP BY DestAirport
        ) AS sub
    )
);
